items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So that was also another learning experience for me... thinking of Donald Byrd, he was one of the people that was involved in that, so we maintained our friendship.

ctx.x: So, Billy went off. Donald was in the hospital, he had a back problem which kept him in the hospital for a couple of years. And so, I just being a kid with baseball and all the other things that kids do. All of a sudden at about age twelve, maybe going on thirteen, I got this real interest in playing music, really, I want to play music.
You don't remember what sparked it? Or…
